errors.name: ProductSKUExistsError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to create a product with a SKU that already exists in the inventory.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested by SKU but not found in the inventory.

errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested by category but that category does not exist in the inventory.
